== Appium automation on iOS

- In native iOS automation sessions, Get Element Attribute now returns `null` when the element does not have the requested attribute, as defined by the https://w3c.github.io/webdriver/#get-element-attribute[W3C WebDriver specification]. Previously, the request failed with an HTTP 500 error, and Appium clients could take about 25 seconds to report the failure after retrying. Attributes that the element has, such as `type` and `enabled`, return their values as before.
